parent_objective: design bounded public diagnostic comparison over scene-backed support candidates
blocked_by: M2216 admits only bounded diagnostic comparison design, not ranking
supersedes: direct task repair before using scene-backed diagnostic support

public_gates: M2217 must design a bounded diagnostic comparison over scene-backed candidates only
M2217 must define output tables as diagnostics, not promotion or paper gates
M2217 must not run reset, rollout, measured execution, policy action, training, replay, or PPO
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs a bounded diagnostic comparison over M2215 scene-backed candidates without ranking
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no rerun ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if scene-backed candidate filtering is absent
stop if diagnostic tables are treated as promotion gates
stop if global offtrack blockers are ignored
fallback_plan: route to no-rerun implementation if diagnostic design is complete
route to task-quality/profile repair if diagnostic denominator is too weak
stop current-sim comparison branch if bounded diagnostics cannot be made claim-safe
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2216 result audit admits bounded diagnostic design

admission_evidence: M2216 routes only to diagnostic design
allowed_updates: M2217 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for no-rerun implementation
next_stage_criteria: routing rule after diagnostics is explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2217 designs outcome diagnostics and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No history-necessity intervention is run in M2217.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If diagnostic tables remain profile-local or offtrack-dominated, route to repair/stop instead of weakening comparison standards.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: turns validity audit into a bounded diagnostic comparison design
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can decide whether current public panel has diagnostic comparison value before repair/stop
must_synthesize_if: M2217 cannot define a claim-safe diagnostic table
implementation would only repeat profile-only support

hypothesis: A bounded diagnostic comparison design can use scene-backed M2215 candidates without creating ranking or paper-level claims.
success_criteria: design lists exact input artifacts and scene-backed candidate filter
design defines diagnostic tables and blocked claims
no reset rollout measured execution training ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 claim is made
failure_criteria: new rollout or ranking is performed
decision_rule: M2217 passes if it freezes a claim-safe bounded diagnostic comparison design without ranking or rerun.
